phase-serial.note: Models run one after another on the same GPU; batch_seconds excludes load/warm-up.

phase-parallel.note: Both processes load their model before the start barrier; only the batch window is compared with serial. Two processes on one GPU do not add compute throughput automatically.

serial.note: Models run one after another on the same GPU; batch_seconds excludes load/warm-up.

parallel.note: Both processes load their model before the start barrier; only the batch window is compared with serial. Two processes on one GPU do not add compute throughput automatically.

serial_vs_parallel.interpretation: serial_sum_over_parallel_wall > 1 means the parallel compute window was shorter than the sum of the two serial batches (overlap paid off) -- but inspect per-model batch seconds: each model is usually slower under contention, so per-sample latency/RTF degrades even when total wall drops. < 1 means contention made the parallel window longer than serial.
